ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark grey/black) with approximately 15% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels localized to the lateral lobe tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous low-intensity region across the central 70% of the fluke width. High-contrast white/grey mottling patterns are restricted to the distal extremities of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with an internal pixel angle of approximately 45 degrees; the vertex is partially occluded by water surface turbulence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude (1-4 pixel) variations along the upper boundary of the left lobe. The right lobe exhibits a smoother, more continuous linear boundary with fewer discrete peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex curve originating from the median notch, terminating in upward-swept distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity white pixels at the terminal tips of both lobes, indicating localized surface irregularities.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of at least four parallel, diagonal dark linear disruptions on the right lobe, crossing through the lighter mottled region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable parallel linear rake marks on the right lobe and irregular serration patterns on the left lobe trailing edge.
